evidence.reason: At the current tip, prepare_run still allocates and stores free_port() in the returned run record. Because free_port() releases its socket before returning, two runs prepared before either boots can receive the same port; booting the second then binds the stored port and fails, and retrying reuses that same stored value. This is a genuine minor implementation bug in the existing prepare/boot flow, not a new requirement or protection-scope proposal. No supplied history commit fixes it.
